title: Repository Enterprise Evidence Model
description: Repository-level enterprise evidence model for SoA-support mapping, proof evidence register, threat and abuse-case posture, SDK dependency governance, observability evidence standards, access review posture, backup/restore posture, incident and vulnerability evidence, privacy/data minimisation, done-state governance, lane evidence requirements, and explicit non-claims. This is evidence organization only, not certification or readiness approval.
aiGuidance: Every implementation lane must update this model when adding implementation, proof, validator, adapter, deferred-boundary, or evidence work. Do not treat these rows as ISO/SOC certification, production readiness, staging readiness, live-provider readiness, full dev readiness, or full React parity.
